name: DSR Mitty
author: Malachite Laurent
description: Party mitigation and all six tank pairings, from the Thordan checkpoint through Dragon King Thordan.

phases.note: Times start at the Thordan checkpoint. This sheet does not assign the P1 door boss.
Brightwing bait order: healers, melee, ranged, tanks. Use the assigned shields before the first bait.

mechanics.note: Healers need to mitigate tanks for this buster.
